Name: CP Bigger Shed
Author: BethKitten
Description:
Made the big shed even bigger but not super huge or divided into sections.  This mod was created for mobile users but might work for the newer versions also, so give it a try if you want.

Walls and Floors can not be changed even though there are two sections, floor and wall, that you will have to edit to get everything matching.  You can find the flooring needed to do this in this mods assets folder.  Unpack and look under the assets file for the walls and floor file.  Easily make your own modified mod for walls and floor by changing out the png file in another walls and floor mod you already have downloaded.

Downloads.Description: Download with required mods, unzip into mods folder, and enjoy.
